$comment: 自然科學探究與實作 + cross-subject + 自然 exam-skills outline. v1 holds only the 116 sprint track (S1). Edit this JSON, never docs/curriculum/.
subject: inquiry
decisions: 116 sprint first (owner, 2026-11-15): review chapters for students who studied the required science in school; full lessons follow for 117.
Owner requirement (2026-11-16): a cross-subject part after the subject units, analysing one context with physics, chemistry, biology and earth science.
Exam-tested skills beyond the 必修 text (Lenz, dimensional analysis, ionic-equation balancing) are taught once, in the exam toolkit chapter, each justified by a verified past item.
Practice papers are original and only modelled on the 111–115 layout; official papers are linked, never copied.

Owner approved the 自然 sprint outline (2026-11-16): keep the 60-chapter size; write ONE subject at a time (rate limits); biology relies on the shared inquiry exam-skills part; the shared 自然 mock is the only science practice paper; environment-energy stays one chapter.
openQuestions: Integrator: the subject files were written in parallel; if their terminal review chapters change, update the twelve subject prereqs of s116x-one-context-four-subjects and the three of s116-sci-exam-toolkit.

Should s116-inq-argue-model take math/s116-data-analysis (scatter plots, correlation) as a prereq? The 課綱 text says to organise data with math, but the research names no math code, so it is not added.

The 12 考試說明 測驗目標 codes (exam:nat-2a…5a) are reviewed in both exam-skills chapters because the registry gives one shared description for all of them; split them by goal once each goal's wording is in the registry.
Exam-item links (examItems) are added per chapter in S2; reviewed concepts (reviews) once their glossary entries exist.

Integrator (2026-11-16): s116-sci-mock cannot list the subjects' exam-skills chapters (physics/s116-physics-mixed-groups, chemistry/s116-chem-written-items, earth/s116-earth-data-items) as prereqs, because the structure rule allows only sprint review chapters as cross-subject prereqs. Decide whether that rule should also allow sprint exam-skills chapters.

question.zh-tw: 科學家怎麼從一個現象走到一個可信的結論？
question.en: How does a scientist get from a phenomenon to a conclusion you can trust?

parts.whyHere: Verified earth-inquiry units 27–31: overview, then 發現問題 → 規劃與研究 → 論證與建模 → 表達與分享 (depends_on chain 28→29→30→31), with the planner's 學習表現 mapping (po/ti → 發現問題, pe → 規劃與研究, pa/tr/tm → 論證與建模, pc/tc/ah/an → 表達與分享). Unit 27: no 地科 prerequisite and it can be taught before or alongside the subject units, so this part has no cross-subject prereqs. Correction: some 考試說明 items target 探究與實作 alone (外傘頂洲 Q1), so it gets its own review. Strands 1–2 are merged into one chapter (both short, and 113 Q43 tests them together).

note.zh-tw: 給已在學校修過自然科學探究與實作與必修物理、化學、生物、地球科學，準備考 116 學測的同學：重點複習，不是從零開始。完整的從零課程將在 117 學年度課程中推出。
note.en: For students who took 自然科學探究與實作 and the required physics, chemistry, biology and earth science in school and sit the 116 GSAT: a focused review, not zero-to-hero. The full lessons arrive in the 117 course.

title.en: Finding problems and planning an investigation

blurb.zh-tw: 從觀察現象到可驗證的問題，再到找出變因、擬定計畫與收集數據。
blurb.en: From observing a phenomenon to a testable question, then to variables, a research plan and data collection.

objectives.zh-tw: 從情境中形成可探究的問題，並提出可驗證的觀點
objectives.en: Turn a context into a researchable question and a testable claim

objectives.zh-tw: 找出操縱、應變與控制變因，並預測結果
objectives.en: Identify manipulated, responding and controlled variables and predict the result

objectives.zh-tw: 評估資料來源的可信度與研究計畫是否可行
objectives.en: Judge how reliable a source is and whether a plan can work

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review: the four strands have no fixed order and may cycle (課綱); 發現問題 then 規劃與研究 (verified units 28→29). Official items to link: 113 Q43 (variables, predicting results; per its scoring guide variables must be physical quantities and predictions must relate them), 考試說明 金門 tide item and 外傘頂洲 Q1–Q2. Original worked contexts, self-check quiz.

blurb.zh-tw: 整理數據、作圖找趨勢，從證據推理出結論，並建立模型、說出它的限制。
blurb.en: Organise data, plot it to find trends, reason from evidence to a conclusion, and build a model and state its limits.

objectives.zh-tw: 把數據整理成圖表並描述趨勢與規律
objectives.en: Organise data into charts and describe trends and patterns

objectives.zh-tw: 分辨相關與因果，用證據支持主張
objectives.en: Tell correlation from cause and back a claim with evidence

objectives.zh-tw: 建立簡單模型並指出它的適用範圍與限制
objectives.en: Build a simple model and say where it applies and where it fails

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review (verified unit 30, after 規劃與研究; uses 國中 Ea-Ⅳ-1~3 units and scale as background). Official items to link: 考試說明 尼伯特 buoy item (解釋和推理), 115 Q50 (plot tide data, compute the tidal range). Chart reading is a verified cross-subject skill (more than half of 115 chemistry items used charts). Original data sets, self-check quiz.

blurb.zh-tw: 用正確的術語、符號與模型表達結果，評價別人的方法並提出改進。
blurb.en: Present results with correct terms, symbols and models; critique others' methods and propose improvements.

objectives.zh-tw: 用正確的科學術語與符號表達探究結果
objectives.en: Present inquiry results with correct scientific terms and symbols

objectives.zh-tw: 評價實驗設計與資訊的可信度，提出改進
objectives.en: Critique an experiment design and the credibility of information, and propose improvements

objectives.zh-tw: 說明科學解釋可以被檢驗與修正
objectives.en: Explain that scientific explanations can be tested and revised

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review (verified unit 31, after 論證與建模). Official items to link: 考試說明 外傘頂洲 wave/coast item (評價與省思), 115 Q54 (tick C-14 and justify in no more than 20 characters). Value reproducibility; science is one explanation, not the only one (課綱 key concepts). Original critique-the-experiment tasks, self-check quiz.

question.zh-tw: 同一個現象，四科各看到什麼？
question.en: What does each of the four subjects see in the same phenomenon?

parts.whyHere: Owner requirement: a cross-unit lesson after all subject units. Verified: every year 112–115 Part 2 had cross-subject 題組 (112 物/地 Q51–54; 113 物/生 Q40–43 and 化/地 Q50–53; 114 生/地 Q40–43; 115 生/化 Q40–43 and 地/物 Q50–53). Real 題組 pair two subjects; the four-subject analysis is our teaching design, not an exam claim. Placed after the inquiry part because the analysis uses its strands; its first chapter takes every terminal review chapter of the four subject courses as prereqs, so every subject review chapter is an ancestor (sprint review → sprint review; the subjects' exam-skills chapters cannot be cross-subject prereqs under the structure rule).

note.zh-tw: 給已在學校修過自然科學探究與實作與必修物理、化學、生物、地球科學，準備考 116 學測的同學：重點複習，不是從零開始。完整的從零課程將在 117 學年度課程中推出。
note.en: For students who took 自然科學探究與實作 and the required physics, chemistry, biology and earth science in school and sit the 116 GSAT: a focused review, not zero-to-hero. The full lessons arrive in the 117 course.

blurb.zh-tw: 同一個情境，分別用物理、化學、生物、地球科學分析，再整合成一個解釋。
blurb.en: Analyse one context with physics, chemistry, biology and earth science in turn, then combine them into one explanation.

objectives.zh-tw: 從同一情境中找出四科各自可以回答的問題
objectives.en: Find the questions each of the four subjects can answer about one context

objectives.zh-tw: 用跨科概念把四科的分析連成一個完整解釋
objectives.en: Link the four analyses into one explanation with the cross-cutting concepts

chapters.activity: Cross-subject (owner requirement): 2–3 original contexts, each analysed by all four subjects, organised by the 課綱's seven cross-cutting concepts (物質與能量、構造與功能、系統與尺度、改變與穩定、交互作用、科學與生活、資源與永續性). Link the official two-subject 題組 as real examples (112 物/地 Q51–54, 113 化/地 Q50–53, 114 生/地 Q40–43, 115 地/物 Q50–53); do not claim the exam combines all four in one 題組. Prereqs: every terminal review chapter of the four subject courses (each review chapter that no later review chapter of its subject builds on), so all subject review comes first.

blurb.zh-tw: 讀一份跨科的圖表或資料，判斷每一小題要用哪一科的觀念。
blurb.en: Read one cross-subject chart or data set and decide which subject's ideas each sub-item needs.

objectives.zh-tw: 讀懂跨科圖表，判斷每一小題需要的學科觀念
objectives.en: Read a cross-subject chart and decide which subject's ideas each sub-item needs

objectives.zh-tw: 從資料提出證據，寫出跨科的推理
objectives.en: Pull evidence from the data and write out cross-subject reasoning

chapters.activity: Cross-subject data practice: original 題組 built on charts and tables mixing the four subjects; each sub-item tagged with the subject idea and inquiry strand it uses (考試說明 tags items with strand sub-items, sometimes as the sole target: 外傘頂洲 Q1). Respect each subject's 課綱 depth limits (e.g. 必修 Faraday induction is qualitative; no complex equation balancing). Subject prereqs come through s116x-one-context-four-subjects.

question.zh-tw: 知道答案之後，怎麼在自然考卷上拿到分數？
question.en: Once you know the answer, how do you earn the points on the science paper?

parts.whyHere: Verified unit 32 (exam skills: mixed groups, plotting, showing working, word-limited explanations) depends on units 1–31, so it comes last. Exam-format concepts are owned by the site exam-literacy part; these chapters only apply them to 自然. The toolkit holds verified exam-tested skills outside the 必修 text (physics corrections on Lenz and dimensional analysis; chemistry units 8 and 14). The original practice paper is the finale, as in math.

note.zh-tw: 給已在學校修過自然科學探究與實作與必修物理、化學、生物、地球科學，準備考 116 學測的同學：重點複習，不是從零開始。完整的從零課程將在 117 學年度課程中推出。
note.en: For students who took 自然科學探究與實作 and the required physics, chemistry, biology and earth science in school and sit the 116 GSAT: a focused review, not zero-to-hero. The full lessons arrive in the 117 course.

blurb.zh-tw: 依評分原則作圖、從表格計算，並寫出完整的計算過程。
blurb.en: Plot, compute from tables and write out full working the way the scoring guides expect.

objectives.zh-tw: 依題目要求描點、連線並從圖表讀出數值
objectives.en: Plot and join points as asked and read values off a chart

objectives.zh-tw: 寫出評分原則要求的計算過程與單位
objectives.en: Write the working and units the scoring guides ask for

chapters.activity: Applies the site exam-literacy part to 自然 Part 2. Verified: non-choice answers must show calculations or reasoning, or marks are deducted; scoring is set per item (111 Q38 all-or-nothing, Q57 partial 1 of 2). Official items to link: 115 Q50 (plot tide data plus tidal range; only about half got the range right). Original practice items.

blurb.zh-tw: 在字數限制內寫出關鍵理由，並用物理量寫出變因與預測。
blurb.en: Give the key reason within a word limit, and state variables and predictions as quantities.

objectives.zh-tw: 在限字內寫出得分的關鍵理由
objectives.en: Write the scoring reason within the word limit

objectives.zh-tw: 用可測量的物理量寫出變因與預測
objectives.en: State variables and predictions as measurable quantities

chapters.activity: Official items to link: 115 Q54 (tick C-14 and give a reason in no more than 20 characters), 113 Q43 (scoring guide: variables must be physical quantities; predictions must relate quantities). Original practice items with model answers and common deductions.

title.zh-tw: 考試工具箱：課本之外的常考技巧
title.en: Exam toolkit: tested skills beyond the 必修 text

blurb.zh-tw: 冷次定律的推理、因次分析、離子方程式的原子與電荷守恆：課綱未列為必修，但考題曾出現。
blurb.en: Lenz's-law reasoning, dimensional analysis, and balancing ionic equations by atoms and charge: not in the 必修 text, but tested in past papers.

objectives.zh-tw: 用冷次定律判斷感應電流的方向
objectives.en: Use Lenz's law to find the direction of an induced current

objectives.zh-tw: 用因次檢查公式與答案
objectives.en: Check formulas and answers by their dimensions

objectives.zh-tw: 依原子與電荷守恆平衡離子方程式
objectives.en: Balance ionic equations by conserving atoms and charge

chapters.activity: Each skill flagged as beyond the 必修 text and justified by a verified item: Lenz (冷次 is not named anywhere in the 自然領綱; the 113 Q46(b) and 115 Q53(a) scoring guides require it; teach qualitatively, since 必修 Faraday is qualitative); dimensional analysis (因次 is elective 力學一 PEa-Va-1, so role beyond; 112 Q37–40 was framed with 因次分析 and Q40 penalised wrong dimensions); ionic equations by atom plus charge conservation (111 Q57-2 dichromate–Fe2+; 氧化數 and redox balancing are 選修; the 必修 limit is no complex equations). Prereqs: physics/s116-induction, chemistry/s116-equations-stoichiometry, chemistry/s116-redox.

blurb.zh-tw: 題型與配分仿照 111–115 學年度試卷的原創自然模擬卷。
blurb.en: An original science practice paper laid out like the 111–115 papers.

objectives.zh-tw: 在限時內完成一份完整的自然模擬卷
objectives.en: Complete a full science practice paper against the clock

objectives.zh-tw: 對照詳解找出要回頭複習的章節
objectives.en: Use the worked solutions to find the chapters to revisit

chapters.activity: Original full paper laid out like the 111–115 papers (layout facts come from src/data/registry/exam/papers.json, not this outline); the four subjects at roughly equal shares per the 116 簡章; worked solutions link back to each subject's sprint chapters. Subject prereqs come through s116x-one-context-four-subjects.
